summary: Verified 'Riwayat Preventif' feature end-to-end. Backend: reran pytest /app/backend/tests/test_checksheet.py -> 10/10 pass (checksheet APIs & RBAC unchanged). Frontend Playwright: (1) Sidebar has 'Riwayat Preventif' after 'Perbaikan & Riwayat' for both admin+user (route /preventive-history). (2) Admin sees 'Kelola Template' and 'Isi Checksheet Baru'. History table shows 1 row (GOLIVE, seeded) with 'X OK / Y Tidak OK' summary, last saved date. (3) Admin 'Buka' opens ChecksheetDialog containing 'Simpan Checksheet' + 'Tambah Item' controls; 'Cetak BAP' triggers PDF download (BAP-Checksheet-GOLIVE--.pdf) without JS errors. (4) 'Kelola Template' opens TemplateManager dialog. (5) 'Isi Checksheet Baru' opens pick-schedule-dialog; after creating a schedule with no checksheet, the picker lists 1 option and confirming opens the ChecksheetDialog for that schedule. (6) /schedules page for admin: 0 'checksheet-schedule-*' actions, no 'manage-templates-button' — cleanup complete; add/edit/delete row buttons still present. (7) Operator user: does NOT see manage-templates-button nor new-checksheet-button; button label reads 'Lihat'; dialog is read-only (no Simpan/Tambah Item/Tambah Sub); 'Cetak BAP' download works.

design_issues.screen: Riwayat Preventif row for seeded GOLIVE
issues: Seeded GOLIVE checksheet has no due_date and all items lack result -> summary shows '0 OK · 0 Tidak OK' and Jatuh Tempo shows '-'. Cosmetic/data-only, not a code bug.

critical_code_review_comments: PreventiveHistory.js hasChecksheet filter is guarded on Array.isArray(items) && items.length>0 — correct definition of 'terisi'.
isAdmin gates both 'Kelola Template' and 'Isi Checksheet Baru' as well as the 'Buka' vs 'Lihat' label; ChecksheetDialog receives isAdmin to enforce read-only mode.
Schedules.js no longer imports ChecksheetDialog/TemplateManager and no per-row Checksheet button — dead code fully removed.
pick-schedule-dialog uses shadcn Select; when pending list is empty, shows fallback message 'Semua jadwal sudah memiliki checksheet.' — good UX.
generateChecksheetPDF is client-side jsPDF; download tested for both admin and user without JS errors.
Layout.js: 'Riwayat Preventif' entry placed at correct index (after 'Perbaikan & Riwayat') and rendered for both roles.
test_credentials: Admin: admin / Admin#2026 ; User: operator / Operator#2026
seed_data_creation: TEST_UI_PICK schedule created via UI and deleted after test. Ensured at least 1 filled-checksheet row exists (seeded via API on GOLIVE machine schedule) before UI test — no lingering test data.

Seeded GOLIVE checksheet has items with empty result and null due_date, so its summary is 0 OK / 0 Tidak OK — expect >=1 row but summary numbers may be zero.
